main_measure.name: mean short-direction unusual next-day move of cases (forecast falls >= 2 points)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases pooled by day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with day-pooled t >= 2 (and supporting diff > 0); reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move of middling cases (forecast <= -5) minus that of largest rises (rise_lin post <= -18)

decided_by: Positive main measure with t >= 2 but the supporting difference is at or below 0 (or missing).
reading: Cases are short-side bets per the holding-period rule (forecast size rising >= 2 points from its lowest short size since the last bet, from 0 at a window's start or after a flat), on every bar since the grid is 1 bar; largest rises are up-day bars with rise_lin post_pipeline_value <= -18 whether or not they are cases, counted as distinct days; day-pooled t uses per-day summed deviations with a G/(G-1) factor.
